name: arith_liouville_sum_card_divisors_cube
statement: (n : ℕ) : ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, d.divisors.card ^ 3 = (∑ d ∈ n.divisors, d.divisors.card) ^ 2
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, d.divisors.card ^ 3 = (∑ d ∈ n.divisors, d.divisors.card) ^ 2
informal: Liouville's identity Σ_{d|n} τ(d)³ = (Σ_{d|n} τ(d))² — both sides are multiplicative in n; on p^a it is Σ_{j=1}^{a+1} j³ = (Σ j)² (Nicomachus).
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, d.divisors.card ^ 3 = (∑ d ∈ n.divisors, d.divisors.card) ^ 2
